title: Rise & Conquer
description: Rise & Conquer is a Minecraft Civilizations server that is never ending. It prioritizes Geopolitics, Roleplay, and Worldbuilding.
body:
# Rise and Conquer

**Rise and Conquer is a roleplaying Minecraft Towny Civilizations server powered by player-made nations, geopolitics, and war.**

Here, players can fight for control through various means, including Capture the Zone, Capture the Flag, Killpoints, and territory conflicts.

The server features a custom raiding system, along with tons of other custom content like dungeons, mobs, and items. Other features include a player-driven economy and a chest shop marketplace, as well as player-hosted events, voting rewards, and more.

The Rise and Conquer server is for Java Edition only, supporting all versions between 1.21.4 and 1.21.11. Check out the server's rules and guides link below, then join and let this exciting new adventure begin!
